background: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group is one of Japan's three megabanks, the holding company of Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, SMBC Nikko Securities and a consumer finance arm, with growing operations in the United States and Asia.
synthesis: Rated A on average across all three, the weakest of them at A-, all on a stable outlook; the last move was a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 8 Dec 2022. Capital is the weak spot against Asian banks, with CET1 of 12.4% and leverage of 5.0% both in the bottom quarter. No liquidity figures are carried, and there has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
